column1: # What each measured endpoint is, in one place.
# The generator prints these beside a rate; without them the caption would have to
# describe a route in code, and a description typed into a Python constant is a
# second copy of a fact that belongs with the data. The route set is defined by
# `apps/azera/Bootstrap.php`; this file says what each one measures.
# Columns, tab separated. `#` starts a comment and blank lines are ignored.
#   endpoint  the route path exactly as `matrix.sh` recorded it in the run rows
#   summary   one clause, lowercase, no trailing period: it is interpolated into
#             the sentence "All servers served the same routes: <endpoint>
#             (<summary>)." so it has to read as a parenthesis.
